File Information
Collection: API3-OrderStatusMatrix
Environment: EShop Local (HW06)
Collection Description
Data-driven Collection Runner sweep of the full 5x5 FR-10 state-transition matrix, driven by postman/data/order-status-cases.csv via `newman -d`. Each of the 25 iterations creates its own fresh order (so no iteration can corrupt another's starting state), walks it via legal hops to the CSV row's fromState, then attempts the row's toState and asserts the spec-correct expectedStatus. The two EXPECTED-FAIL rows (A3-D-15: shipping->canceled, A3-D-24: canceled->delivered) are expected to fail, evidencing the same two defects the hand-written API3-AdminOrderStatus collection already found (the missing shipping-cancel whitelist arm, and BUG-05).
